Ntizo · the customer home page proposal v3 · 7 Sep 2026 · pt-MZ copy is a draft, annotations in English
What changed Desktop Mobile With today's photos What it needs

v3 · the two blocks you called out

Show the product, not a description of it

Two blocks were still wrong. "Como funciona" was three white cards floating above three paragraphs on a white page — the card kit the listings threw out, and nothing bound a step to its words. It is now the app itself: three phone screens carrying the real flow, each under its numbered step. "O que dizem os clientes" had three footers sitting at three different heights because the reviews are different lengths; the name and the business now sit on one baseline whatever the quote runs to, and each review carries the business it is about, with its photograph, as a link.

Six decisions

  1. A hero with weight

    The claim in navy, the listings' search pill at 64px, and three proofs under it: fixed price, verified people, M-Pesa. Beside it a collage of three photographs of the work at different scales, not one square. White ground, no art, no wave.

  2. Categories as photo tiles

    Eight square tiles, one image per category, set once by an administrator. On a home page a category is something to browse, so it gets a picture; the icon strip stays on /services, where it is a filter.

  3. Services with prices, before providers

    The section called "popular services" showed providers. It now shows eight services on the exact tile /services draws, price in navy. That is the thesis, and it was missing from the page.

  4. "Como funciona" is the app

    Three phone screens carrying the real flow: the results with their prices, the day with its free hours and the M-Pesa total, the confirmation that reveals the address and the phone number. A numbered step and one sentence above each. Nobody has to imagine what booking looks like.

  5. Reviews that line up

    The score, the words, then the reviewer and the business on one baseline across all three, however long the quote. The business carries its photograph and links to its page, so a review is a way in rather than a dead end.

  6. One dark band, one blue

    The only dark surface is a full-width navy band for the other reader, with the brand's tie pattern and three facts a provider cares about. The only blue on the page is the search button.

Desktop · 1440 · signed out

The page

Scaled to fit. Every photograph here stands in for one a provider uploads or the company commissions; the last section shows the same page with the pictures the data has today.

The header is the listings header with the pill removed, plus "Tornar-se prestador" as plain text: the second audience gets a door at the top, not only in the footer. One component, a plain variant beside search. On scroll the compact pill can dock into the header once the hero's search has left the viewport; a nicety for later, drawn nowhere here.

The hero says the offer and proves it. Headline in navy, one sentence that names the trades a visitor came for, the listings' pill at 64px, and three proofs with a line icon each. The collage is three photographs of work at different scales; the company needs to own three good ones shot in Maputo, or the column draws navy tiles.

Categories are photo tiles, eight square, label under each, "Todas as categorias" for the rest. The image is the category's own imageUrl, which the admin form already sets and nobody has filled; until it is filled the tile is navy with the category's icon in white, as the section below shows.

"Serviços populares" now shows services. Eight tiles on the exact tile /services draws, so there is one component to maintain, and a fixed price, an hourly one and a quote all appear as they really do. No buttons anywhere in the grid.

"Como funciona" is the app on the device customers use. Three screens: a category browse where every row carries its price and duration, the booking screen with the day, the free hours (09:00 taken, 14:00 chosen) and the M-Pesa total, and the confirmation that hands over the address and the phone number and asks how it went. A numbered marker and one sentence above each, because this is a real sequence and the numbers say so. The phone bezel is the only dark thing here besides the band; it is a device, not a card.

Reviews line up. The reviewer's row and the business row sit on one baseline across all three columns whatever the quote runs to — the middle one is deliberately short to show it holds. The business row carries its photograph, its service and a chevron, and is the link to its page. The month comes from createdAt, which the read model already returns.

The band is the one dark surface. Full width, tie pattern, three plain facts, a white button so the page's single blue stays on the search.

Phone · 390 · the same page, top to bottom

Mobile

Three windows onto one scroll. The tab bar the app already has stays; the hero's search becomes the one-row pill that opens the search sheet the listings use. Categories are a four-across grid; services and providers ride a rail with peek and snap.

First screen: the headline, the sentence, the pill, the three proofs and the collage. The pill is one row, service over city, and opens the same sheet the listings open.

Categories four across, two rows, then "Todas as categorias". Services ride a rail of two-and-a-bit tiles; providers at four-fifths width. Both are the existing ScrollRail.

No phone drawn inside a phone. On the device, each step is its number, its sentence and then the screen itself, borderless on a hairline — the frame would be redundant. Reviews stack with the same business row; the band keeps its pattern; the footer folds to two columns above the tab bar.

Honest about the pictures

With the photographs the data has today

No category has an image and no provider has uploaded a photograph. This is how the first two sections render tomorrow: a category tile is navy with its icon in white, a service tile is navy with the tie pattern and the provider's initials. Both still read as one intentional page, which is the test the current placeholder fails.

Honest about the data

What this needs that the page does not have today

A "popular services" read. The page today asks for verified providers sorted by rating. The services section needs the service list the browse page already queries, with its "Sugeridos" ordering and a limit of eight. Nothing new on the server.

Category images. The field exists and the admin form sets it; nobody has uploaded one. Eight images, once, by an administrator. The empty state is drawn above so the section ships before they exist.

Three photographs the company owns for the hero collage: real providers at work in Maputo. Until then the collage draws navy tiles. Provider uploads fill the rest of the page over time.

A plain header variant. SiteHeader gains plain beside search: the same right-hand cluster plus "Tornar-se prestador", no centre column. The landing's overlay mode, the generated SurfaceArt and the wave are deleted with the hero that used them.

Copy in eight locales. The headline, the sentence, the three proofs, the three steps, the band and the section heads are new strings in landing.json; reviews and provider names are never translated.

Not proposed, because no data exists for it: counts ("500 prestadores"), response times, "reservado N vezes", and a city other than Maputo. The sentence says Maputo because that is where every listed business is.
